checks.name: Start atomically creates the session, attempt and private frozen questions
Twelve concurrent retries create one drill and replay its original selection
Foreign request identity stays private and changed selection cannot reuse an ID
Different-selection start races have one winner and leave one session/source
No matches, empty IDs and malformed limits leave no orphan session
A failure on the final source insert rolls back the preceding session and attempt
Editing prompts and removing live keys does not alter a started drill or its score
Substituted questions are rejected before any scoring effects
Concurrent start replay and twelve completions through the wrapper produce one receipt and reward
Browser roles cannot start, read frozen keys, or bypass the completion wrapper
Legacy attempts created by the previous Edge can still complete and replay
Notebook retries require ownership and replay the same owned review
Concurrent different actors retain separate starts and source rows
